insights.summary: The agent successfully identified and implemented the core architectural change requested (Mixtral Expert Parallelism). However, it failed on verification and severely compromised the repository integrity by staging and committing thousands of unintended file deletions/changes, resulting in a 17MB patch file.
strengths: Strong high-level architectural understanding of MoE optimization.
Comprehensive coverage of all requested target files.
weaknesses: Poor attention to git state and staging constraints.
Failure to debug and resolve runtime errors in verification scripts.
Modified files outside the allowed target list.
